sections.installation:
1. Install plugin via WordPress admin or WordPress.org
  2. Create a free account in settings
  3. API key is automatically configured
  4. Customize your opt-in modal and notifications
  5. Start sending your first campaign 🚀
sections.faq:
What is Web Push?

Web Push is a browser-based notification technology that lets you send messages directly to your visitors’ devices — even when they are not on your site. Unlike email, push notifications appear instantly on desktop or mobile, helping you boost engagement, recover abandoned carts, and increase conversions.

Why do I need to sign up on Digital Conversion after installing the plugin?

Because the push notification service is fully managed in our cloud. This ensures reliable delivery, powerful analytics, and no server stress for your WordPress hosting. The plugin is just the connector — the SaaS does the heavy work.

Do you offer AI features?

Yes! Our AI engine analyzes your campaigns and gives clear insights and optimization tips.

Is A/B testing really included in all plans?

Correct! Even free users can run A/B tests to optimize engagement.

Is it free to start?

Yes. Free plan includes 1000 push/month, unlimited subscribers, unlimited segmentation, and A/B testing.

Does it support WooCommerce?

Yes. Full WooCommerce integration for cart recovery, product view tracking, and conversion attribution.

Can I use it for multiple sites?

Yes, premium plans include multi-site support. Agencies love it.

How does this plugin compare to other push notification plugins?

Our focus is simplicity + performance: unlimited subscribers, built-in segmentation, A/B testing on all plans, and AI-powered campaign insights. Unlike many alternatives, delivery happens on our servers, not yours — so your WordPress stays light and fast.

Will push notifications slow down my WordPress site?

No. All processing and delivery run in our cloud infrastructure. The plugin only connects your site to our service, so your hosting resources are not affected.

Do I need coding skills to use it?

Not at all. Setup takes just a few clicks. You don’t need to edit code or configure APIs manually — everything works directly from your WordPress dashboard.

Does it work with multilingual sites (WPML, Polylang)?

Yes. Push campaigns can be created in multiple languages, and you can segment subscribers by browser language for better engagement.

Can I track conversions from push notifications?

Yes. With WooCommerce integration, you can track product views and abandoned carts.

Is it GDPR / LGPD compliant?

Yes. We only collect data after explicit user consent, and you control your subscribers. Our platform is fully compliant with GDPR (EU) and LGPD (Brazil).

Can agencies use it for clients?

Yes. Agencies can connect multiple websites under one account, manage campaigns separately, and scale easily.
